title: Chest CTA (aorta)
text:
Chest CT angiography

Hx) Chest pain, r/o PE / AD.

Pulmonary artery: filling defect 없음, no PE.
Aorta: Ascending aorta 4.4 cm 로 dilatation. Dissection, intramural hematoma 없음.
  Arch 3.2 cm, descending 2.8 cm.
Lung: 양측 basal subsegmental atelectasis.
Heart: mild cardiomegaly.

Imp)
1. No PE. No aortic dissection.
2. Ascending aortic aneurysm, 4.4 cm. 1년 후 f/u CTA 권함.
teaches: Ascending aortic aneurysm with Korean-English advice: rule and MedGemma agree.

basis: The record says: “No aortic dissection. 2. Ascending aortic aneurysm, 4.4 cm. 1년 후 f/u CTA 권함”
